newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to call second special meeting.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to call second special meeting.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Monday it will call a second special meeting of shareholders to consider the company's reorganization plan, which includes changing its status to a fully private corporation from a government-sponsored enterprise.
Sallie Mae said the meeting would be called because shareholders of more than one-third of its outstanding shares have returned the necessary agent designations for a second special meeting.
Pending formal notification and verification, Sallie Mae said it will set a meeting date and time.
Sallie Mae said it welcomes the comparison of its slate of directors, restructuring plan and business plan against whatever any dissident shareholders have to offer.
